$comment: Everything the BSBM harness takes from outside this repository is pinned here, and nothing is vendored.
The BSBM Tools archive is fetched by URL and refused unless its sha256 matches (benchmarks/dataset-pin.mjs).
Container images are named by digest, never by tag: a tag moves, and a benchmark against a moved image is
a number nobody can reproduce (design R7).
Verified 2026-11-25: the archive was downloaded twice (sourceforge redirect and the direct mirror URL) and
both copies hash alike; the temurin and oxigraph digests were read from `docker image inspect` after a
pull of the tag named in `tag`; oxigraph 0.5.13 prints `oxigraph 0.5.13`.

bsbmtools.licence: Apache-2.0 per the project page https://sourceforge.net/projects/bsbmtools/ (the archive carries no licence file)

temurin.use: runs the BSBM generator and the BSBM test driver (Java, prebuilt jars from the archive)

oxigraph.use: the reference SPARQL engine (licence Apache-2.0 OR MIT)

mongo.use: the scratch Ythril instance's database, the digest docker-compose.yml pins

seeds.generatorNote: fixed in the generator's source (Generator.seedGenerator), not an option: the same product count gives the same dataset
seeds.driverNote: the test driver's default -seed, passed explicitly; it chooses every query parameter

exploreNote: BSBM removed Q6 from the Explore mix; the ticket's 12 is 11 in practice
